values.note: 2026 rate sheet: Modern Electric 30 amp $30 a night, holiday $35, 6 nights $170, 12 nights $250; 50 amp $35, holiday $40, 6 nights $200, 12 nights $310. Primitive Tent Camping $20 per tent, holiday $25. Gate fee $5 per person per day Monday-Friday, $10 weekends and holidays; the rules say 'Car Passes are for campers only, all guests must pay the gate fee.' Waste station for non-campers $25.

fees.source: https://www.in.gov/counties/cass/france-park/images/FparkRates-6-29-26.png ('2026 FRANCE PARK RATES', file dated 6-29-26), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Modern electric sites book online on Firefly, by phone or in person; phone reservations Monday-Thursday 9-6 only. Primitive sites are first come, first served, check-in 1-9 PM, 6-night maximum. Electric sites are paid in full when booked. Check-in 1 pm, check-out noon. On 2026-10-31 Firefly refused both November 2026 and June 2027 dates ('This unit cannot be reserved this far in the future').

booking.source: https://www.in.gov/counties/cass/france-park/rates-and-reservations ('Primitive Campsites are non-reservable'; 'Maximum of 12 Nights in Modern Electric Sites, and 6 Nights in Primitive Sites'; 'Reservations shall be made from Monday to Thursday from 9:00AM to 6:00PM only') + https://www.in.gov/counties/cass/france-park/activities ('Reserve a modern site online, by phone, or in person.'), read 2026-10-31

hookups.source: https://www.in.gov/counties/cass/france-park/activities ('130 sites have electricity which consists of 30 amp, 50 amp, and 110 Volt plug-ins. Water hook-up is also available for most modern sites. There is no direct sewer hook up but we do provide a dump station.'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: The county says 'over 200' with 130 electric; green sites on its modern map are long-term/seasonal only. Firefly lists 92 units, 83 of them fit 23 ft; D1-D9 (15 ft) and G1, J8 (20 ft) don't.

sites.source: https://www.in.gov/counties/cass/france-park/activities ('over 200 wooded campsites, both primitive and electric') + https://app.fireflyreservations.com/reserve/property/FrancePark (per-unit 'Fits RVs up to N ft'; longest 65), read 2026-10-31

facilities.source: https://www.in.gov/counties/cass/france-park/activities ('we do provide a dump station. The campground has two shower houses'; 'The Old Kenneth Depot Store that sells ice, groceries, fishing and camping supplies'), read 2026-10-31

note: Cass County park near Logansport, with an old quarry for swimming and scuba, and a fishing lake. The county's maps page says the primitive campsites are under renovation, and its home page says the swimming area is closed until further notice (both read 2026-10-31). --Claude
summary: Fees added ($30 30-amp, $35 50-amp, $5 reservation fee, from the county's 2026 sheet image); electric 50, water, no sewer; max 65 ft; online on Firefly plus phone (stored 'phone' was stale); 12-night max; showers, dump, store. Pin 300 m off.
flags: PIN: stored 40.76106,-86.45956 is the US-24 gate. Modern sites' centre on imagery about 40.7592,-86.4570 (loops and pads visible), ~300 m SE. Beyond the 250 m line.

WATER: the on-water claim in the old note can't be confirmed: no county page names on-water primitive sites. Its primitive map (Upper Triangle only, 'locations are not exact', currently 'under renovation') shows the Wabash & Erie Canal beside the triangle, not the river or quarry. The rate sheet prices it 'Primitive Tent Camping (Per Tent Per Night)', so RV fit of the primitive sites is not established; Upper Triangle UT sites do list 50 amp and water with 'Fits RVs' figures on Firefly while the county's page calls them non-reservable. The modern sites are not on water on imagery. Not waterfront stands; dropped the on-water line from the note.

PARTIAL CLOSURES: 'The swimming area will be closed until further notice!' (county home page) and 'The beach is closed for the season!' (Firefly); 'The primitive campsites are currently under renovation' (maps page). Campground itself operating; no status written.

GATE FEE: $5/$10 per person per day on the 2026 sheet. Whether registered campers pay it isn't stated beyond 'Car Passes are for campers only, all guests must pay the gate fee' and '2 vehicles per site', so I did not write fees.entrance; a phone call would settle it (574-753-2928, confirmed).

LOCAL: county park on Cass County's in.gov pages; public can book an ordinary night (modern sites); green sites and long-term season (May 1-Nov 1, $2030 / $2230) 'completely booked', separate from nightly.
